purpose: Executable row-level matrix for Runtime Soak #2. This artifact plans the proof run and does not claim row completion by itself.

status_policy.mock_policy: Mocks, seams, component tests, and docs are prerequisites only unless the row also runs through the assembled runtime path and emits retained evidence.

setup.local_repo_root: Run from the repository root or from the bound issue worktree.
setup.aws_profile_policy: AWS-backed rows must use the approved Agent Logic business profile agent-logic-admin and record account-resolution proof without printing credentials.
setup.operator_boundary: Rows that need live provider, AWS, Unity editor, or promoted feature credentials must either retain proof artifacts or remain blocked/non-claimed with operator approval.

rows.fixture_setup: Consume the canonical minimal runtime path from #4681 after PR #4868 lands, then run the ADL runtime compatibility binary from a clean worktree.
rows.negative_case: Repeat with a missing or malformed workflow path and require fail-closed diagnostics plus no integrated_proven row exit.
rows.blocker_policy: If #4681 remains unmerged or the assembled path cannot run, classify blocked with #4681/#4682 evidence; do not substitute component-only runtime tests.
rows.v092_readiness_impact: Blocks v0.92 runtime-coherence claims until one assembled runtime path runs with retained evidence.

rows.fixture_setup: Use the inherited long-lived-agent fixture from the v0.91.6 integrated soak runner until #4681 replaces it with the current canonical runtime path.
rows.negative_case: Stop the agent after proof capture and require the stop probe to distinguish stopped state from copied/restarted continuity.
rows.blocker_policy: If only the inherited v0.91.6 runner works, keep the row blocked or routed to Soak #3 unless #4682 proves the same lifecycle cases in the v0.91.7 assembled path.
rows.v092_readiness_impact: Blocks continuity and birthday-runtime claims if startup, wake, stop, and copied-state distinctions remain unproven.

rows.fixture_setup: Consume the v0.91.6 ACIP/AEE/memory integration fixture as prerequisite evidence, then require #4682 to attach it to the assembled runtime path.
rows.negative_case: Run the AEE denial/malformed request path and require a governed rejection artifact rather than silent success.
rows.blocker_policy: If the command remains only a prerequisite harness and is not integrated with the assembled runtime, mark blocked with owner issue #4697 or route to Soak #3.
rows.v092_readiness_impact: Blocks temporary-agent execution claims if governed AEE execution cannot run in the integrated path.

rows.fixture_setup: Use v0.91.6 ACIP/AEE artifacts only as prerequisites; require WP-12 protocol/access-rule disposition before final row exit.
rows.negative_case: Malformed, denied, and failed-delivery cases must fail closed and identify access/protocol residual ownership.
rows.blocker_policy: Remain blocked until WP-12 issues #4658-#4660 either prove the protocol path or record operator-approved non-claim/blocker evidence.
rows.v092_readiness_impact: Blocks ACIP/A2A activation claims unless operator explicitly approves a non-claim.

rows.fixture_setup: Consume WP-05 provider profile, model suitability, cheapest-validated-outcome, local-agent delegation, and Fable5 suitability packets as routing inputs.
rows.negative_case: Missing credential or provider timeout must classify as provider_auth_missing/provider_timeout without corrupting runtime state.
rows.blocker_policy: If live provider execution is unavailable, #4682 may retain a blocked row with credential/operator evidence; do not claim live provider readiness from mock adapters alone.
rows.v092_readiness_impact: Blocks provider-backed runtime claims where v0.92 depends on live or cheapest-validated model routing.

rows.negative_case: Force local, cheap-remote, premium, delayed, and governor-like choices to produce explainable decisions or fail closed.
rows.blocker_policy: If no integrated scheduler decision appears in the runtime packet, classify blocked; component-level scheduler artifacts remain prerequisites only.
rows.v092_readiness_impact: Blocks premium-capacity and cheapest-validated-outcome runtime claims if not visible in live packets.

rows.fixture_setup: Consume #4783 scheduler watcher/AEE middleware after PR #4869 lands, then run #4784 failure-injection proof in the assembled path.
rows.negative_case: Retry, timeout, cancellation, bulkhead partial failure, degraded fallback, and remote timeout must be retained and classified.
rows.blocker_policy: If #4783/#4784 are not landed or the proof uses only inherited v0.91.6 harnesses, block or route to Soak #3 with operator approval.
rows.v092_readiness_impact: Blocks resilience claims for the activation runtime path.

rows.fixture_setup: Consume merged #4718 proof packet and rerun the focused verifier before or during #4682.
rows.negative_case: Machine-readable stdout must remain parse-safe while adl_event observability stays on stderr or compatibility log; retained samples must pass path/secret hygiene.
rows.blocker_policy: If stdout/stderr separation, redaction, heartbeat, provider/runtime correlation, or OTel boundary truth regresses, block v0.92 logging readiness.
rows.v092_readiness_impact: Already issue-proven by #4718, but must be consumed by #4682 before sprint closeout.

rows.fixture_setup: Verify the Agent Logic business AWS profile before live checks; local/mock heartbeat artifacts are prerequisites unless live signal evidence is retained.
rows.negative_case: Missing AWS profile, denied SNS/SSM access, or heartbeat publish failure must fail closed without exposing credentials.
rows.blocker_policy: Remain blocked until WP-08 heartbeat, ACIP-to-SNS, AWS signal bridge, SSM, and archive-policy issues prove or explicitly non-claim the signal path.
rows.v092_readiness_impact: Blocks runtime AWS/signal bridge claims unless operator approves a non-claim.

rows.fixture_setup: Use Unity 6.5 editor when available; consume #4652/#4704 retained proof summaries and feed the Soak-generated Unity contract into the staged project.
rows.negative_case: Headless entitlement, readonly project database, timeout, or missing success markers must become blocked proof, not silently pass.
rows.blocker_policy: If Unity cannot execute in the current environment, classify blocked with retained log path and require operator approval before any non-claim.
rows.v092_readiness_impact: Blocks live Observatory consumption claims if it only consumes canned data or stale renders.

rows.fixture_setup: Consume signed/unsigned transition-memory artifacts from the v0.91.6 ACIP/AEE/memory packet and attach the handoff to the current runtime path.
rows.negative_case: Unsigned, missing, or private-path-leaking handoff must fail validation and remain a blocker.
rows.blocker_policy: If memory handoff remains a request shape only, block v0.92 memory-handoff claims or route to #4697 with explicit residual risk.
rows.v092_readiness_impact: Blocks long-running context memory continuity claims where v0.92 depends on retained handoff evidence.

rows.command_or_harness: cargo run --manifest-path adl/Cargo.toml --bin adl-runtime -- identity now --json
rows.fixture_setup: Consume Runtime v2 reconciliation from #4842 and the canonical runtime path from #4681; retain identity/continuity snapshots in the #4682 packet.
rows.negative_case: Copied state, stale lease overlap, stopped state, and true wake continuity must be distinguishable in retained evidence.
rows.blocker_policy: If identity checks are standalone and not tied to runtime start/wake/stop packets, classify as prerequisite-only and block row completion.
rows.v092_readiness_impact: Blocks continuity and birthday identity claims.

rows.fixture_setup: Consume ACC/capability contract validation and WP-12 access-rule/security disposition before #4682 final row exit.
rows.negative_case: Missing accountable actor, mismatched capability grant, or overbroad side-effect scope must fail closed.
rows.blocker_policy: Block unless the assembled runtime packet names capability/authority limits for runtime and temporary agents or operator approves a non-claim.
rows.v092_readiness_impact: Blocks capability-envelope claims and witness/receipt readiness if authority limits remain implicit.

rows.fixture_setup: Consume WP-12 security residual readiness and protocol/access-rule issues; security rows require fail-closed integrated behavior, not docs-only closure.
rows.negative_case: Malformed output, unauthorized access, private-state exposure, and trust-boundary violations must fail closed with retained diagnostics.
rows.blocker_policy: Remain blocked until WP-12 resolves activation blockers or records evidence-backed operator-approved non-claims.

rows.surface: Curiosity / Constructability, if promoted before run
rows.command_or_harness: No default command. Promote only if #4692 or #4693 lands an executable governed discovery/admissibility harness before #4682.
rows.fixture_setup: If promoted, require a governed discovery cycle or constructability anchor validator fixture with operator-approved scope.
rows.negative_case: Rejected hypotheses, inadmissible anchors, or ungoverned side effects must fail closed.
rows.blocker_policy: Default is explicit non-claim; promotion requires owner issue evidence and operator approval before it can block or pass Soak #2.
rows.v092_readiness_impact: Does not block v0.92 unless explicitly promoted into the activation path.
